items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-05-27
items.q: It's in the era of the first big bands, because the really first good big band to migrate into Texas was Alfonso Trent.

ctx.x: He played rags and popular songs, you know.
That's what it was. It's in the era of the first big bands, because the really first good big band to migrate into Texas was Alfonso Trent.

items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1969-12-30
items.q: the history of Troy Floyd's band goes way back to the days of Alfonso Trent... I visited the estate just a couple of three years ago.

ctx.x: Well, tell me a little bit more about Troy Floyd's band. I don't know too much about it, it's what you've told me.

Well, the history of Troy Floyd's band goes way back to the days of Alfonso Trent, who was a band that was organized with Texas musicians and Arkansas, because Trent originally was from a little town of Fort Smith, Arkansas. His estate was still there, I visited the estate just a couple of three years ago. And Trent was playing at the Adolphus Hotel, incidentally the first name of a band to be put into one of these big establishments. So Troy had his band organized with mostly Texas men. And the great trumpet…
Well, how did he play then? Did he use many head arrangements? Would he just be faking all the time or what? I don't know.
